findings.title: §4.7 commit-message catalog omits the new "pr body" commit
findings.detail: The "Commits." bullet enumerates every message takt commits with (`wave <n> — tasks…`, `plan → execute`, `archive`) but not the `takt(<slug>): pr body` commit that `preparePushPR` (internal/cli/cmd_next.go) now makes when it writes `finish/pr.md`, before the session's `push_pr` runs `git push`. This is a branch-wide behavior change (run's own spec.md: "next commits finish/pr.md in the commit the push carries", goal G6, tested by TestPushPRLeavesTheBodyInHead) that this final docs wave did not fold into the invariant list it lives next to.

findings.title: §7.5 step 4's `pr` disposition prose doesn't mention finish/pr.md is committed before the push
findings.detail: The paragraph describing `pr: run push_pr` says the body file path (`inputs.pr_body_path`, naming `finish/pr.md`) is handed to the session for `gh pr create --body-file`, but never says takt commits that file into the branch first (subject `pr body`) so the pushed branch already carries the PR body it was created from. A reader of this section would still believe the body is only written to disk, not committed — the exact behavior issue #62's first half changed, per the run's own spec.md and internal/cli/cmd_next.go's preparePushPR doc comment ("Committing here... is what puts finish/pr.md in the branch before the session pushes it").

findings.title: review_error gate's dynamic retry text (backends.<name>.timeout) is undocumented
findings.detail: internal/decide/questions.go's questionReviewError now names the specific `backends.<name>.timeout` key (and its current deadline) in the retry option's description when the review errored, falling back to the literal placeholder key when no backend can be named — a branch change (run spec G5). Line 814 still describes the gate only as "(retry / skip this task's review with reason / stop)" with no mention of this. This matches the doc's existing terseness for other gates' option text, so it's a minor gap rather than a clear regression.
